spec: Every fielded or arriving unit has a unique unsigned 32-bit RNG identity. Caller identities survive roster ordering and reload; automatic allocation reserves them first and never reuses a dead unit's identity. Trigger dice use target identity and an explicit target-presence domain.
expect: Both setup paths reject invalid identities and allocate uniquely. Restored arrivals, ownership, attack and trigger dice follow stable identities. Trigger key correction deliberately changes baselines, measured against the preceding commit.
note: Independent review reproduced trigger target array-index dependence and no-target/index-zero aliasing. Four additional regression cases failed before the trigger correction; baseline changes are declared before implementing that correction. The allocator alone already passed 971 tests with unchanged controls.
